commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: TAsyncServer accept() should only count the pending events
commits.body:
- fSockets.fRead.PendingCount is the length of the whole fPending[] array, including the events already consumed by GetOnePending(): with several reading threads and short connections, the array is only reset when a reading thread takes its last event, so once HttpQueueLength (default 10000) connections were queued in a row, the new ones were closed as if the server were overloaded
- use the thread-safe Pending method instead
- new HttpAcceptPending regression test, with a single request worker kept busy
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: replaced EHttpSocketOverflow by ESizeOverflow
commits.body: - so that decompression could use and identify the new MaxSize parameter
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: new THttpSocketCompress prototype definition
commits.body:
- to have a new MaxSize optional parameter
- used now in THttpRequestContext.UncompressData to avoid out of memory attacks
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

- to use a new MaxSize parameter
- to raise exceptions on all decoding error
- to reduce memory usage

- to raise exceptions on decoding error for consistency
- to reduce memory usage

commits.subject: net: front controller with TSynTempAdder, and ReturnLocalFile() shared with OnGetHeadLocalFolder
commits.body:
- as reviewed in #810: OnFastCgiIndex() decodes the path within the TSynTempAdder of OnFastCgi(), which then holds the path to send, instead of a RawUtf8 and a local TSynTempBuffer
- new THttpProxyUrl.ReturnLocalFile() computes the file name and the SHA-256 cache key, then calls ReturnFile(): it is used by OnGetHeadLocalFolder() and by the front controller for static files
- with fSettings.Url[i] do in THttpProxyServer.Start
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: TFastCgiAsyncConnection.OnClose did not call inherited OnClose
commits.body:
- so fClosed was never set, and Destroy called OnClose a second time
- also fixed THttpProxyServerMainSettings.ThreadCount comment: the default is
  the number of CPU cores + 1, not 4
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: front controller support for fcgi:// Sources with THttpProxyUrlSettings.FastCgiIndex
commits.body: As suggested in #785, with FastCgiIndex = 'index.php', a request is resolved as nginx try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$query_string does: a script path is sent as usual, an existing file is returned as from a local folder, a folder path ending with '/' goes to its index script if any, and any other path to the root index script with REQUEST_URI unchanged.
commits.author: zen010101
